verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments, and lists bill pay as part of the platform. The Payments API supports managing vendors and sending ACH, wires, and checks, so the core flow is claimed first-party. However, the evidence is only single-line marketing copy with no detail on bill upload or approval routing. missing for 10: documentation of bill upload/ingestion mechanics, configurable multi-step approval routing rules, approval-gated payment release, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can upload bills and route them through an approval workflow before paying vendors
